question: Should ClawHub preserve documented lowercase and legacy skill filename aliases while rejecting only case-colliding packages, or adopt an uppercase-only contract with a migration?
rationale: The issue title asks for uppercase enforcement, but current documentation intentionally supports aliases and the reporter later recommended the narrower collision-only rule; selecting the permanent package contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve aliases, reject collisions
options.body: Continue accepting one supported alias per package while rejecting any case-insensitive path collision before discovery, upload, or storage.

options.title: Migrate to uppercase only
options.body: Deprecate lowercase and legacy aliases through a documented compatibility window, then require canonical uppercase filenames.

recommendation.title: Preserve aliases, reject collisions
recommendation.body: Continue accepting one supported alias per package while rejecting any case-insensitive path collision before discovery, upload, or storage.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent GitHub import feature work is the clearest current-main ownership signal for the affected discovery contract.
